concepts.title: Setting Up an Equation
concepts.definition: An equation is a condition on a variable. To set up an equation, identify the unknown, denote it by a letter (x, y, etc.), translate the statement into mathematical operations, and equate to the given value.
concepts.key_idea: Identify unknown, denote by letter, translate words to math, equate.
question_patterns: write the statement as an equation

the sum of three times x and 11 is 32

solution_steps.explain: Find what is unknown, denote by a letter like x, y, m, n
Convert words to math: 'sum' = +, 'difference' = -, 'times' = x, 'of' = x, 'divided by' = /
Set expression equal to the given value

compute_steps.action: substitute the given values and simplify
compute_steps.explain: substitute the given values and simplify: val = 3 * 2 + 8 gives 14

concepts.title: Variable and Expression
concepts.definition: A variable is a quantity that can change, denoted by a letter. An expression is formed by performing operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) on variables. The value of an expression depends on the value of the variable.
concepts.formula: expression = operations on variable; value depends on variable
concepts.key_idea: Variables change, expressions depend on variables.
question_patterns: verify by giving values to variable
find value of expression for x =

solution_steps.explain: The letter that can change
Replace variable with given value
Compute the result

compute_steps.action: substitute the given values and simplify
compute_steps.explain: substitute the given values and simplify: val = 3 * 9 + 3 gives 30

concepts.title: What Equation Is
concepts.definition: An equation has an equality sign. LHS = RHS. At least one side must contain the variable. An equation remains the same when LHS and RHS are interchanged.
concepts.formula: lhs = rhs; at least one side has variable
concepts.key_idea: Equation has = sign. LHS = RHS. Can swap sides.

solution_steps.explain: Equation must have = sign
At least one side must contain a variable
Left of = is LHS, right of = is RHS

compute_steps.action: use the congruence condition and angle sums
compute_steps.explain: use the congruence condition and angle sums: third = 180 - 58 - 74 gives 48

concepts.title: Solving Equation by Balancing
concepts.definition: To solve an equation, perform the same mathematical operation (add, subtract, multiply, divide by same non-zero number) on both sides to isolate the variable. The balance is maintained.
concepts.formula: if a = b, then a+c = b+c, a-c = b-c, a*c = b*c, a/c = b/c (c != 0)
concepts.key_idea: Same operation on both sides keeps balance. Goal: isolate variable.
question_patterns: first step to separate the variable

solution_steps.explain: If +n on LHS, subtract n from both sides. If -n, add n. If x*n, divide by n. If /n, multiply by n.
Apply same operation to both LHS and RHS
Variable should now be isolated on LHS
Substitute value back into original equation to verify

concepts.title: Transposing Terms
concepts.definition: Transposing means moving a number or term from one side to the other. When transposing, change the sign (+ becomes -, - becomes +). Same as adding/subtracting from both sides.
concepts.formula: transposing +n from lhs to rhs becomes -n; transposing -n becomes +n
concepts.key_idea: Move term to other side, flip its sign. Same as balancing.
question_patterns: change the side of the number

solution_steps.explain: Find the term to move to the other side
+ becomes -, - becomes + when moved to other side
Combine like terms on each side
Divide or multiply to isolate variable

concepts.title: Solving Equations with Brackets
concepts.definition: To solve equations with brackets like 4(m+3) = 18, first divide both sides by the coefficient to remove brackets, then solve.
concepts.formula: a(b+c) = d -> divide by a -> (b+c) = d/a -> transpose c -> b = d/a - c
concepts.key_idea: Divide by coefficient to remove brackets, then solve.

solution_steps.explain: Divide both sides by the number outside brackets to remove brackets
Move the constant inside brackets to the other side, changing sign
Compute the value of the variable
Substitute back to verify

concepts.title: Applications to Practical Situations
concepts.definition: Convert word problems into equations, then solve. Identify the unknown, set up the equation from the statement, and solve for the variable.
concepts.key_idea: Translate words to equation, solve, interpret answer.

concepts.key_idea: Equation can be expressed in many word forms.
